cond_0001.intro: Work directly with Director of E&E or a Construction Manager to help plan and supervise construction projects in energy conservation, clean tech, and district energy using effective communication, scope determination, estimating, negotiation, scheduling, tracking, subcontract management, document control, and forecasting of costs and profitability. Manage teams of professionals from different disciplines and ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Essential Job Functions:
Collaborate with engineers, architects, and other professionals to determine and deliver project specifications.
Work with pre-construction and energy engineering to determine design-build conceptual scopes for maximum energy conservation and utilization.
Create/compile both conceptual and detailed estimates for general contracting services (subcontractor scopes) using RSMeans or other relevant estimating manuals and procedures.
Prepare or support the preparation of project budgets and proposals (scope letters).
Secure permits and licenses.
Track, forecast, report labor hours and all associated project costs.
Buyout major equipment and subcontracts.
Create, manage, and implement master project schedule(s).
Secondary Job Functions:
Develop and maintain client relations.
Support the development of energy models and life cycle cost analysis.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Ability to accurately compile estimates.
Ability to understand and communicate concepts in many construction methodologies and procedures of construction.
Advanced organizational and time management skills.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Advanced computer skills including MS suite of products (Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint).
Maintain a valid Driver's License and satisfactory driving record.
Preferred Requirements:
Working knowledge of AutoCAD, Solid Works, Smartsheet, Viewpoint, AutoDesk Construction Cloud (ACC), Office 365, SharePoint, Revizto, Quick-Pen, EstMEP, Blue Beam (Adobe), Navisworks, and competency in applications of various types (IoT).
Construction Management or Engineering degree.
A minimum of two years' experience as a general contractor (manager/estimator/MEP) with a focus on commercial, industrial, and Federal projects.
Association of Energy Engineers (AEE) Certified Energy Manager (CEM) certification and/or Certified Energy Auditor (CEA).
LEED certification.
OSHA 30 certification.

cond_0117.intro: We are looking for an Energy & Environment Construction Engineer to join our team. Working alongside the Director of E&E or a Construction Manager, you will help plan and supervise construction projects in energy conservation, clean tech, and district energy. The work involves coordinating across communication, scope determination, estimating, negotiation, scheduling, tracking, subcontract management, document control, and cost forecasting. You will work with teams of professionals from different disciplines to help ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
cond_0117.responsibilities:
Essential Job Functions:
Coordinate with engineers, architects, and other professionals to determine and deliver project specifications.
Work with pre-construction and energy engineering teams to develop design-build conceptual scopes for maximum energy conservation and utilization.
Collaborate on the creation and compilation of both conceptual and detailed estimates for general contracting services (subcontractor scopes) using RSMeans or other relevant estimating manuals and procedures.
Prepare or support the preparation of project budgets and proposals (scope letters).
Coordinate the securing of permits and licenses.
Track, forecast, and report labor hours and all associated project costs together with the project team.
Work with the team to buy out major equipment and subcontracts.
Coordinate the creation, management, and implementation of master project schedule(s).
Secondary Job Functions:
Develop and maintain client relations.
Support the development of energy models and life cycle cost analysis.
cond_0117.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Ability to accurately compile estimates.
Ability to understand and communicate concepts across many construction methodologies and procedures.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Advanced organizational and time management skills.
Advanced computer skills including MS suite of products (Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint).
Maintain a valid Driver's License and satisfactory driving record.
Preferred Requirements:
Working knowledge of AutoCAD, Solid Works, Smartsheet, Viewpoint, AutoDesk Construction Cloud (ACC), Office 365, SharePoint, Revizto, Quick-Pen, EstMEP, Blue Beam (Adobe), Navisworks, and competency in applications of various types (IoT).
Construction Management or Engineering degree.
A minimum of two years' experience as a general contractor (manager/estimator/MEP) with a focus on commercial, industrial, and Federal projects.
Association of Energy Engineers (AEE) Certified Energy Manager (CEM) and/or Certified Energy Auditor (CEA) certification.
LEED certification.
OSHA 30 certification.

Working closely with the Director of E&E or a Construction Manager, you will help plan and supervise construction projects in energy conservation, clean tech, and district energy. The work involves coordinating across communication, scope determination, estimating, negotiation, scheduling, tracking, subcontract management, document control, and cost forecasting. You will work with teams of professionals from different disciplines to help ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
cond_0306.responsibilities:
Essential Job Functions:
Coordinate with engineers, architects, and other professionals to determine and deliver project specifications.
Work alongside pre-construction and energy engineering teams to develop design-build conceptual scopes for maximum energy conservation and utilization.
Collaborate on the creation and compilation of both conceptual and detailed estimates for general contracting services (subcontractor scopes) using RSMeans or other relevant estimating manuals and procedures.
Support the preparation of project budgets and proposals (scope letters).
Coordinate the securing of permits and licenses.
Track, forecast, and share reports on labor hours and all associated project costs.
Work with the team to buy out major equipment and subcontracts.
Coordinate the creation, management, and implementation of master project schedule(s).
Secondary Job Functions:
Develop and maintain client relations.
Support the development of energy models and life cycle cost analysis.
cond_0306.requirements:
Ability to accurately compile estimates.
Ability to understand and communicate concepts in many construction methodologies and procedures of construction.
Advanced organizational and time management skills.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Advanced computer skills including MS suite of products (Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint).
Preferred working knowledge of AutoCAD, Solid Works, Smartsheet, Viewpoint, AutoDesk Construction Cloud (ACC), Office 365, SharePoint, Revizto, Quick-Pen, EstMEP, Blue Beam (Adobe), Navisworks, and competency in applications of various types (IoT).
Construction Management or Engineering degree preferred.
A minimum of two years' experience as a general contractor (manager/estimator/MEP) with a focus on commercial, industrial, and Federal projects is preferred.
Association of Energy Engineers (AEE) Certified Energy Manager (CEM) certification and/or Certified Energy Auditor (CEA) are desirable.
LEED certification is desirable.
OSHA 30 certification is desirable.
Maintain a valid Driver's License and satisfactory driving record.

cond_0319.intro: Work directly with the Director of E&E or a Construction Manager to help plan and supervise construction projects in energy conservation, clean tech, and district energy using effective communication, scope determination, estimating, negotiation, scheduling, tracking, subcontract management, document control, and forecasting of costs and profitability. Manage teams of professionals from different disciplines and ensure projects are completed on time and within budget. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of construction planning and energy systems.
cond_0319.responsibilities:
Essential Job Functions:
Collaborate with engineers, architects, and other professionals to determine and deliver project specifications.
Work with pre-construction and energy engineering to determine design-build conceptual scopes for maximum energy conservation and utilization.
Create/compile both conceptual and detailed estimates for general contracting services (subcontractor scopes) using RSMeans or other relevant estimating manuals and procedures.
Prepare or support the preparation of project budgets and proposals (scope letters).
Secure permits and licenses.
Track, forecast, report labor hours and all associated project costs.
Buyout major equipment and subcontracts.
Create, manage, and implement master project schedule(s).
Secondary Job Functions:
Develop and maintain client relations.
Support the development of energy models and life cycle cost analysis.
cond_0319.requirements:
Ability to accurately compile estimates.
Ability to understand and communicate concepts in many construction methodologies and procedures of construction.
Advanced organizational and time management skills.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Advanced computer skills including MS suite of products (Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint).
Preferred working knowledge of AutoCAD, Solid Works, Smartsheet, Viewpoint, AutoDesk Construction Cloud (ACC), Office 365, SharePoint, Revizto, Quick-Pen, EstMEP, Blue Beam (Adobe), Navisworks, and competency is applications of various types (IoT).
Construction Management or Engineering degree preferred.
A minimum of two years' experience as a general contractor. (Manager/estimator/MEP) with a focus on commercial, industrial, and Federal projects is preferred.
Association of Energy Engineers (AEE) Certified Energy Manager (CEM) certification and or Certified Energy Auditor (CEA) are desirable.
LEED certification is desirable.
OSHA 30 certification is desirable.
Maintain a valid Driver's License and satisfactory driving record.

Coordinate with engineers, architects, and other professionals to determine and deliver project specifications.
Work alongside pre-construction and energy engineering teams to develop design-build conceptual scopes for maximum energy conservation and utilization.
Collaborate on the creation and compilation of both conceptual and detailed estimates for general contracting services (subcontractor scopes) using RSMeans or other relevant estimating manuals and procedures.
Support the preparation of project budgets and proposals (scope letters).
Coordinate the securing of permits and licenses.
Track, forecast, and share reports on labor hours and all associated project costs.
Work with the team to buy out major equipment and subcontracts.
Coordinate the creation, management, and implementation of master project schedule(s).
Secondary Job Functions:
Develop and maintain client relations.
Support the development of energy models and life cycle cost analysis.
cond_0378.requirements:
Ability to accurately compile estimates.
Ability to understand and communicate concepts in many construction methodologies and procedures of construction.
Advanced organizational and time management skills.
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Advanced computer skills including MS suite of products (Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint).
Preferred working knowledge of AutoCAD, Solid Works, Smartsheet, Viewpoint, AutoDesk Construction Cloud (ACC), Office 365, SharePoint, Revizto, Quick-Pen, EstMEP, Blue Beam (Adobe), Navisworks, and competency in applications of various types (IoT).
Construction Management or Engineering degree preferred.
A minimum of two years' experience as a general contractor (manager/estimator/MEP) with a focus on commercial, industrial, and Federal projects is preferred.
Association of Energy Engineers (AEE) Certified Energy Manager (CEM) certification and/or Certified Energy Auditor (CEA) are desirable.
LEED certification is desirable.
OSHA 30 certification is desirable.
Maintain a valid Driver's License and satisfactory driving record.
